title: Missed connection
when: You reached the airport too late for your onward flight.

steps.text: Go to the airline transfer or rebooking desk now and say you missed your connection.
Show your booking code {{current.onward_flight.pnr}} and trip reference {{booking.ref}}.

options.label: No one is at the desk

steps.text: Take a photo of the new boarding pass.
Tell your driver in {{current.city}} about the new arrival time.
Ask for a hotel and meals for tonight. Keep every receipt.
If you need a person, tap SOS to reach our team.

branches.label: No one is at the desk

steps.text: Call the airline number above. If nobody answers, tap SOS.
